Another idea is to get creative with what you already have at home. Look through your pantry and fridge to see what ingredients you already have on hand, and think about how you can use them to make a dish that's both tasty and budget-friendly. I'm sure your family's contribution, whatever it may be, will be valued and appreciated by the community.
